<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Register an ASN"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/asns"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Registers the supplier's announcement of a delivery in state
`Registered`. `asnNumber` (1 to 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`) is
the identity; registering an existing number is 409
`asn-already-exists`. `lines` is non-empty, `lineNo` runs exactly
`1..n` in order, SKUs are unique across lines and every `expectedQty`
is positive. An unknown SKU (not in the `known_skus` local copy) is 422
`unknown-sku`. Publishes `ASNRegistered`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}

Required on every POST. A\nretry with the same key and the same request (method, path and body)\nreplays the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same\nkey with a different request is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`; a missing\nkey is 400 `idempotency-key-required` and one longer than 128\ncharacters or with non-printable characters is 400\n`idempotency-key-invalid`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128},"example":"0b6b1f1e-4a5c-4c1e-9f2a-7d3c8e5f9a01"}]}
>
